summary: GeoPark Ltd filed a Form 6-K providing information regarding its 2026 Annual General Meeting, including the nomination of director candidates and independence determinations. The filing does not involve any change of control, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change. It is a routine procedural update about the upcoming annual meeting and voting procedures, with no special-situation financial or structural event. This maps to a standard US 8-K regarding annual meeting details.
